How to read it

Standard crow's-foot notation. Each box is a database table; connectors show how many rows on one side relate to the other.

Cardinality

Exactly one ||
Zero or one o|
One or many |{

Column keys

PK — primary key FK — foreign key UK — unique

Only signature columns are shown per entity to keep the map legible — the full column set lives in the schema. The one hub everything hangs off is Student (18+ relations); the tenant spine is School → Branch → {Student, Teacher, Class}.

Standalone entities (no declared foreign-key relations — they float on the map): Otp, Milestone, Event, Holiday, Report, Driver, Reaction, MessageReadReceipt, VerificationToken. Some link by loose id (e.g. MilestoneTimeline.milestoneId) without a DB-level relation.

Methodology. Entities, columns and relationships were read directly from prisma/schema.prisma on the current main, encoded as a Mermaid erDiagram, and rendered to a self-contained SVG with @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli.
